definitions.explanation: A person or thing being considered for selection.

examples.english: To be nominated as a candidate.

examples.japanese: {次期|じき}{社長|しゃちょう}の{候補|こうほ}として、3{名|めい}の{名前|なまえ}が{挙|あ}がっている。
examples.english: Three names have been put forward as candidates for the next company president.

notes:
{候補|こうほ} refers to a candidate, nominee, or potential option under consideration.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {候補|こうほ}に{挙|あ}がる: to be nominated, to come up as a candidate
- {候補|こうほ}を{絞|しぼ}る: to narrow down the candidates
- {候補|こうほ}に{立|た}つ: to run as a candidate
- {候補|こうほ}から{外|はず}れる: to drop out of the running

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {候補者|こうほしゃ}: candidate (person)
- {候補地|こうほち}: candidate location/site
- {候補|こうほ}{作品|さくひん}: nominated work

USAGE:
Used in both political contexts (election candidates) and everyday contexts (choosing from options like restaurants or travel destinations).
